claims.claim: Adaptive defense changes defense policy over time.
claims.statistical_evidence: Episode-level transitions=25, increases=14, decreases=11; signals={'MAINTAIN': 49, 'INCREASE_DEFENSE': 28, 'REDUCE_DEFENSE': 23}; temporal mean defense level rises across windows 1–25→76–100.
claims.limitation: Observed on the frozen known protocol only; not a claim of open-world dynamics.

claims.claim: Adaptive defense provides meaningful security against prompt injection.
claims.statistical_evidence: Known Adaptive ASR=0.3733 vs Fixed-L0 ASR=1.0; paired episode-level sign test Adaptive vs Fixed-L0 attack_success survives Holm correction.
claims.limitation: Security is partial (ASR>0). Fixed-L3 achieves ASR=0 but destroys utility. Evidence is protocol-specific (MVP detector/outcome heuristics).

claims.claim: Adaptive defense preserves utility while applying defense.
claims.statistical_evidence: Known Adaptive utility=1.0000 with N_legitimate=25; Fixed-L3 utility=0.0.
claims.limitation: Utility measured on the controlled 25 legitimate episodes only.

claims.claim: Adaptive defense has a measurable security–utility–cost tradeoff.
claims.statistical_evidence: SUC tables report multi-objective values; Adaptive is Pareto-nondominated on known; Fixed-L2 is dominated.
claims.limitation: No single composite score is defined; superiority is multi-objective only.

claims.claim: Adaptation contributes beyond fixed defense levels.
claims.statistical_evidence: Adaptive occupies an intermediate ASR with utility preserved, unlike Fixed-L3; episode-level differences vs Fixed-L0/L3 are Holm-significant for attack_success on known.
claims.limitation: Adaptive is not strictly best on ASR (Fixed-L3 is lower). Contribution is tradeoff-based, not absolute security dominance.

claims.claim: Historical attack feedback contributes to adaptation.
claims.statistical_evidence: Ablation Adaptive with vs without historical signal: identical aggregate primary metrics (historical_signal_changed_aggregates=True).
claims.limitation: Mechanism flag exists and is wired, but under the frozen protocol the historical term does not change discrete decisions or aggregates. No evidence of contribution on this protocol.

claims.statistical_evidence: Known Adaptive family ASR ranges from tool_output_injection≈0.056 to direct_injection≈0.632.
claims.limitation: Family counts are unequal (19/19/19/18) due to first-75 stream slice under 75/25 schedule. Family utility is vacuous (attack-only).

claims.claim: Adaptive defense can handle novel attacks.
claims.statistical_evidence: Novel set has zero exact overlap with frozen stream; Adaptive reports low ASR on novel, but detection_rate=0.0 and Fixed-L0 ASR=1.0. Sanitize success heuristic uses residual known markers.
claims.limitation: MVP attack_success for SANITIZE is defined via residual known malicious markers. Novel marker-free payloads can therefore be labeled unsuccessful after SANITIZE even when detection_score=0. Fixed-L0 (no sanitize) still shows ASR=1.0 on novel, confirming population fairness while limiting claims about sanitize generalization.

claims.claim: Adaptive defense can respond to evolving attack sequences.
claims.statistical_evidence: Evolving stages show changing ASR and mean defense level (defense_level_changes_across_stages=True).
claims.limitation: Evolving construction is deterministic/synthetic. Later novel stages show higher ASR and near-zero detection — response is observed but not uniformly successful.

claims.statistical_evidence: 5 methods × 5 seeds; all methods all_zero_std=true; CI collapses to the mean.
claims.strength_of_evidence: STRONG for reproducibility; NONE for stochastic robustness
claims.limitation: Pipeline is deterministic given frozen stream/schedule. std=0 demonstrates reproducibility, not robustness to random initialization.

definitions.detection_rate: fraction of attack episodes with detection_score >= 0.25

supporting_metrics.semantics_status: Reported metrics match documented formulas (ASR=succ/N_a, DefenseRate=1-ASR, Utility=leg_succ/N_l, DetectionRate=det>=0.25 / N_a, costs/rewards as episode means). Precision/Recall/F1/FPR/Balanced Accuracy are absent from artifacts and must not be claimed.

seed_variance.note: Controlled Phase 7/8A pipeline is deterministic given frozen stream + schedule; cross-seed std is expected to be 0 unless stochastic components are introduced.

limitations: Seed-level t-tests between methods are not used because Phase 8A seed variance is zero under the deterministic controlled stack.
Episode-level sign tests require paired shared episode IDs within a scenario; they are not applied across incompatible populations.
Boolean attack_success differences yield discrete paired signs; effect sizes are reported as mean diff and sign ratio.
statistical_evidence.validity_note: Seed-level inferential tests are not used because std=0. Episode-level paired sign tests with Holm correction are the inferential backbone where populations are paired.

limitations.limitation: Deterministic controlled pipeline yields zero cross-seed variance.
limitations.implication: Supports reproducibility, not stochastic robustness / random-init claims.

limitations.limitation: Only 5 seeds under a deterministic stack.
limitations.implication: Seed CI is non-informative when std=0.

limitations.limitation: Historical-signal ablation does not change aggregates on this protocol.
limitations.implication: Cannot claim historical feedback contributes empirically here.

limitations.limitation: Novel-attack evaluation limited by sanitize marker-residual success heuristic and detector miss rate 1.0 on novel set.
limitations.implication: Generalization / novel-handling claims must remain LIMITED.

limitations.limitation: Novel and evolving sets are closed-world synthetic templates in the same four families.
Attack-family counts unequal (19/19/19/18) under first-75 slice.
limitations.implication: Family comparisons are descriptive, not balanced factorial.

limitations.limitation: MVP rule-based detector/policy; no multi-model LLM coverage.
limitations.implication: External validity limited to this experimental stack.

limitations.limitation: Precision/Recall/F1/FPR/Balanced Accuracy not computed in Phase 7–8C artifacts.
limitations.implication: Those metrics must not appear as evidenced results.

limitations.limitation: Episode-level sign tests use discrete attack_success; seed-level method t-tests intentionally avoided.
limitations.implication: Statistical claims rely on paired episode tests + Holm correction + descriptive SUC.

evidence: Shared phase7_v2_75_25 schedule (75/25) across Fixed and Adaptive comparisons.
Shared first-75 frozen stream fingerprint across Phase 8A methods.
Robustness Known/Novel/Evolving use identical schedule and episode counts.
Known Adaptive ASR consistent across Phase 7, 8A, 8B ablation, and 8C known.
notes: Adaptive without/with historical uses same protocol; difference is null on aggregates.
